Shaikh Ibrahim Shaikh Husain vs The State Of Karnataka on 25 February, 2026

Heard Sri.Abhishek L. Kalled, learned counsel appearing for petitioners, Smt.Kirtilata R. Patil,
learned High Court Government Pleader appearing for respondent No.1-State and Sri.Ganapati M.
Bhat, learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2.

Learned counsel Sri.Ganapati M. Bhat, files a memo, which reads as under:
MEMO "The respondent No.2 submits as follows:
It is submitted that the matter between the husband and wife has been amicably settled.
The parties have already obtained a decree of divorce, and the accused has been acquitted in C.C.No.925/205, resolving all issues between them, including any claim for compensation.
Wherefore, the Hon'ble Court may be please to allow above petition and quash the pending proceedings.

3. Placing the memo on record, the following order is passed:
ORDER
(i) The petition stands allowed in terms of the memo.
(ii) Consequently, the pending C.C.No.925/2025 arising out of Crime No.16/2023 on the file of Principal Senior Civil Judge and CJM, Karwar, Uttara Kannada, is hereby quashed.
